data.content_ref: inline:The isolated block contradicts SRC_001 by demonstrating that the constant-difference shortcut (x≡-2 mod 35 → 33) produces a spurious smallest solution because 3 mod 5 and 4 mod 7 have unequal residues relative to moduli (-2 vs -3), breaking the shared-residue assumption. It is refuted if 33 mod 5 = 3 AND 33 mod 7 = 4 both hold (making 33 a valid solution), or if 18 does not satisfy both congruences (making 18 invalid).
